signal_confirmations.visual_evidence: Buttons like 'Get started', 'Sign in', 'Build now', and 'Plan' all have a very high border-radius, giving them a distinct pill shape.
The dominant accent colors are a vibrant blue (for glows, UI elements) and some orange/red. Purple/violet is present in some gradients but is not the dominant accent across the site.
The main hero section features dark abstract shapes with subtle, soft glows. The 'Ready to build something amazing?' section clearly shows a large, glowing blue, aurora-like shape at its bottom.
The cards throughout the site are dark and mostly opaque or solid, lacking the translucent, frosted glass effect with background blur characteristic of glassmorphism.
Key headings like 'What will you build today?' and 'Ready to build something amazing?' are left-aligned, while other headings are centered.
The 'Everything you need to scale Built in.' section displays multiple feature cards arranged in an asymmetric grid with varying sizes, characteristic of a bento grid layout.
The main headline 'What will you build today?' is solid white and does not feature gradient text.
No floating badge or similar element is visible directly above the main H1.

The hero background and the glowing elements in the 'Ready to build' section display complex, dynamic, and volumetric light effects that strongly suggest rendering beyond standard CSS, likely via Canvas or WebGL.
No clear visual evidence of a specific interactive UI component being rendered within a canvas layer.
This pattern cannot be visually confirmed from screenshots alone.

findings.fix: Add letter-spacing to uppercase labels.

findings.name: Reading width too wide or narrow
findings.reason: Reading widths are not obviously bad.
findings.fix: Constrain paragraph measure to comfortable line lengths.

findings.name: No transition on theme/state changes
findings.reason: Interactive transitions are present.
findings.fix: Add transitions to interactive state changes.

findings.name: Nav has no active/current indicator
findings.reason: Navigation links have no obvious active/current state.
findings.fix: Add active state for the current route or section.

findings.name: Animations are linear
findings.reason: No linear animation timing detected.
findings.fix: Use a custom cubic-bezier easing curve.

findings.name: Scrollbar is browser default
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Style scrollbars when they are visible in the product surface.

findings.name: Selection color is browser default blue
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add branded ::selection colors.

findings.name: No empty state design
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Design empty states for data-driven components.

findings.name: Tooltips use native title attribute
findings.reason: No native title tooltips detected.
findings.fix: Replace title-only tooltips with accessible custom tooltips.

findings.name: Font size does not scale on mobile
findings.reason: No fluid heading type tokens detected in computed snapshot.
findings.fix: Use responsive type tokens or clamp().

findings.name: Disabled states are just opacity
findings.reason: Disabled buttons appear to rely mostly on opacity.
findings.fix: Define disabled color, cursor, and interaction behavior.

findings.name: Images have no meaningful alt text
findings.reason: 12/25 images have missing or weak alt text.
findings.fix: Write useful alt text or mark decorative images empty.

findings.name: Link underlines always on or off
findings.reason: Links appear uniformly underlined or uniformly plain.
findings.fix: Add a link hover/focus underline transition.

findings.name: No custom 404 page
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add a branded 404 route.

findings.name: Paragraph lines too long
findings.reason: Some paragraph lines exceed comfortable reading width.
findings.fix: Constrain paragraph max-width.

findings.name: No favicon
findings.reason: Favicon present.
findings.fix: Add a real favicon and app icons.

findings.name: Modals do not trap focus
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Use a modal primitive that traps focus.

findings.name: No page transition between routes
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add route transitions only where they improve continuity.

findings.name: Input autofill breaks dark mode
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Override webkit autofill colors for dark inputs.

findings.name: Long words and URLs overflow on narrow viewports
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add word-break/overflow-wrap rules.

findings.name: Border colors hardcoded hex values
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Use CSS variables or opacity tokens for borders.

findings.name: Background color stops at content end
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Extend background to full viewport height.

findings.name: No @media print styles
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add print-specific style rules.

findings.name: HTML missing lang attribute
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add a lang attribute to the html element.

findings.name: No skip-to-content link for keyboard users
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add an accessible skip-link.

findings.name: Icon-only buttons missing aria-label
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Provide aria-label or visible text for icon buttons.

findings.name: Form inputs missing autocomplete attributes
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add autocomplete attributes.

findings.name: Form fields show no error state
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add visual and textual error states.

findings.name: Form submission shows no success confirmation
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Show success messages or confirmations.

findings.name: Animated elements missing will-change hint
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add will-change where appropriate to hint the compositor.

findings.name: Interactive elements under recommended touch size
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Increase tap targets to 44×44px.

findings.name: overflow:hidden clips content unexpectedly on mobile
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Audit and remove destructive overflow rules.

findings.name: Hardcoded px spacing everywhere
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Use rem/spacing tokens instead of px.

findings.name: No distinction between :focus and :focus-visible
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Use :focus-visible to avoid mouse-triggered focus rings.

findings.name: Below-fold images missing loading="lazy"
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add lazy loading to below-the-fold images.

findings.name: Missing or incomplete viewport meta tag
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add a responsive viewport meta tag.

findings.name: No color-scheme meta tag
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add color-scheme meta to hint light/dark UI.

findings.name: Heading levels skip (e.g. h1 → h3)
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Fix the document outline and heading hierarchy.
